string.value: 化为一道光束向指定方向传送。传送后短时间内无敌。同时永久提升移动速度和跳跃力。

string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon. Teleports a range of #x, #y. Become invulnerable to physical attacks for a short time after teleport.\n[Passive Effect : Increases Movement Speed by #psdSpeed, increases Jump by #psdJump]
